headline: Ceuta border crisis leaves 67 dead as most migrants return
summary: Spain says about 60,000 people crossed from Morocco, most have returned, and a sea barrier is being installed after deadly attempts to enter the enclave.
script: Spain says most of roughly sixty thousand migrants who crossed into Ceuta from Morocco have returned. At least sixty-seven died in the surge, and a new sea barrier is being installed as European governments plan a coordinated response.
imageAlt: Spanish soldiers assist a migrant on a beach in Ceuta.
